question: Which Indian woman hockey player was made the brand ambassador of the Centre's 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' scheme for Haridwar district in August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vandana Katariya.**__

__
 
• Indian hockey star **Vandana Katariya** was named the brand ambassador of the Centre's 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' scheme for the Haridwar distric

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• India’s hockey star **Vandana Katariya** was named the brand ambassador of the women and child development department of Uttarakhand as well as the brand ambassador of the Centre’s ‘Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao’ scheme for the Haridwar district.
 
• Uttarakhand Chief Minister **Pushkar Singh Dhami **announced a cash reward of **Rs 25 lakh** to Indian women's hockey team member Vandana Katariya for her performance at the Tokyo Olympics.
 
• The announcement was made at a program organized to felicitate the recipients of the **Tilu Rauteli Award **and **the Anganwadi Workers Award **This program was held at the IRDT Auditorium at Survey Chowk.
 
• **Vandana Katariya** created her piece of history at the Olympics when she became the first Indian woman hockey player to score a hat-trick at the Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manpreet Kaur** is a professional Olympic shot putter from India.
 
• **Rashmita Minz** is a hockey player from India. 
 
• **Rajani Etimarpu **is an Indian field hockey and member of the Indian women's national field hockey team.
